title: Embedding Content
description: Learn how to embed external content like other web pages, videos, maps, and interactive objects using HTML tags.

lessons.title: Introduction to Embedding Content
lessons.content: Embedding content allows you to display external resources such as videos, maps, and other web pages directly inside your HTML document.

lessons.title: The <iframe> Element
lessons.content: The <iframe> tag embeds another HTML page within the current page. It can be used for embedding videos, maps, and other web content.

lessons.title: Attributes of <iframe>
lessons.content: Important attributes include src (source URL), width, height, frameborder, allowfullscreen, and sandbox for security.

lessons.title: The <object> Element
lessons.content: The <object> tag embeds multimedia like PDFs, Flash content, or SVG images. It provides fallback content if the object cannot be loaded.

lessons.title: Difference Between <iframe> and <embed>
lessons.content: While <iframe> embeds an entire HTML document, <embed> is used primarily for multimedia content like videos, audio, or interactive plugins.

lessons.title: Security Considerations
lessons.content: Embedding content from untrusted sources can lead to security risks. Use attributes like sandbox on <iframe> to limit capabilities.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Embedding Content
lessons.content: Always provide fallback content, use responsive design techniques for embedded content, and ensure accessibility for all users.
